column4: Write the library implementation used by the console project.
column6:
["--out", "{vars.home}\FSharpMultiProject\FSharpLibrary\Library.fs", "--text", "namespace FSharpLibrary

module Say =
    let hello name = printfn "Hello %s" name
"]
column16: Library.fs written after Visual Studio created the project.

column4: Write the initial console program before the IntelliSense edit.
column6:
["--out", "{vars.home}\FSharpMultiProject\FSharpConsole\Program.fs", "--text", "open System

[<EntryPoint>]
let main argv =
    printfn "Hello world from F#"
    0
"]
column16: Program.fs written after Visual Studio created the project.
